name: Porsche 911 Carrera / Carrera S (997.2)

It is simpler and cheaper to keep running than the i8's hybrid drivetrain, and its no-IMS 9A1 engine removed the big 997.1 risk, though radiators, coolant pipes and PDK can still bring big bills. Values jumped during the pandemic and have since leveled off, so it is more likely to hold its money than the i8.
